item.title: Glutathione Face Cream for Glowing Skin, Day and Night Radiance Cream with Niacinamide and Alpha Arbutin - Fair N Pink, 10 g
item.description: Fair N Pink Advance Radiance Cream in a 10 g jar. A premium glutathione face cream in a silver jar with a crystal lid. It combines L-glutathione, niacinamide (vitamin B3) and alpha arbutin to help skin look brighter, more even and glowing, and to reduce the look of dark spots and dull skin. Use it as a day and night cream: a pea-sized amount on clean skin, with sunscreen in the daytime. No steroids, mercury, hydroquinone or parabens. Patch test before use. Cosmetic product; results vary.
